description: Reference history scanned at the close of 2024-01-17, the day after the leg-out.
explanation: A second explosive leg-out candle (RB 728) completes the strength points, so the completed candles at this close give 7/7 (RB 661, 829) and the untouched zone passes G1 and G2. Later gates are not asserted here: this scenario is about when the zone becomes a candidate.
title: The follow-through candle completes 7/7: one candidate
